headline: Automatic Data Processing (NASDAQ:ADP) Delivers Dividend Quality with Strong Profitability
summary: ADP shows a solid dividend profile: 7/10 Dividend Rating, 2.58% yield, and strong profitability. But health and valuation risks warrant caution.
